Valley of the Kings, Tutankhamun’s Tomb & Hatshepsut Temple | Luxor Egypt Vlog
Welcome to Day 6 of our Egypt travel adventure! In this video, we take you deep into the heart of Luxor, home to some of the most iconic sites of ancient Egypt.
We begin by exploring the legendary Valley of the Kings, where the tombs of Egypt’s greatest pharaohs are hidden beneath the desert hills. One of the highlights? Entering the tomb of King Tutankhamun—the boy king whose treasures changed history forever!
